name: Moholy-Nagy: Light-Space Modulator
promptTemplate: Moholy-Nagy's Light-Space Modulator running in {{palette}} with speed {{motion_speed}}, grille density {{grille_density}}, shadow depth {{shadow_depth}}, spiral density {{spiral_density}}, beam intensity {{beam_intensity}}, and strobe effects {{strobe_fx}}.

palette.hint: Swap color filters and tungsten lamp moods

motion_speed.hint: Speed up the rotating discs and spirals

grille_density.hint: Change frequency of sliding louver bars

spiral_density.hint: Add twists to the glass helix shadow

listing.blurb: László Moholy-Nagy's 1930 kinetic sculpture casts dynamic shadows, rotating discs, and caustic light rays across a projection wall.
listing.prompt: Moholy-Nagy's Light-Space Modulator: a rotating kinetic sculpture of perforated metal discs, glass spirals and grilles throws moving, overlapping shadows and reflections across a white wall, in black and white. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
